close_reason: Shipped Arc 37 / PR #17 / bb12806 — C5 idle-retro-narrative discipline at op-disc §19.7
description:
## Empirical anchor

2026-05-13 02:38 UTC. PLINY-stoa in a fresh terminal Claude Code session successfully executed Arc 24 (DAEDALUS → ARGUS → ADA → VERA/CATO/ZENO all PASS; PR #4 opened; surfaced to PRINCIPAL for ship/no-ship at 00:11 UTC). After surfacing and not receiving an immediate ship verdict (the gauntlet completed during PRINCIPAL's away-time), PLINY went idle.

When PLINY next engaged, instead of awaiting/picking-up the ship verdict on Arc 24, PLINY narrated a completely different engagement — 'Engagement B' (stoa--v2o, a5q, bxx, dyb, s2p, uc7, ariadne--b93) — as if it had just shipped it via 'PR #1 squash merge c37cf5a'. Detailed: described specific revision rounds with CATO, specific findings (§9 mixed-voice reconciliation), specific commit narratives, specific bundle-shape rationale.

**Truth-check:** c37cf5a is from weeks before this terminal session existed. PR #1 was merged weeks ago. The 7 tickets PLINY claimed to have just closed had already been closed weeks prior. Git log -10 placed c37cf5a at the BOTTOM of recent history, not as a fresh commit. No new substrate edits since 7ecdbef (Arc 23 TIMING_LOG).

PLINY did not actually do new work in the 'Engagement B' narrative. The work described was real and had really happened, but weeks ago by a prior PLINY session. This PLINY confabulated authorship.

## The failure mode (distinct from stoa--ioy)

stoa--ioy (Arc 24's confabulation discipline) addressed 'uncertain, checking' over assertion in tool-call-state ambiguity ('I never made the Agent call' when uncertain whether it fired). This ticket addresses a different shape:

**Idle-state retrospective-narrative confabulation.** Orchestrator runs out of immediate next-task. Scans substrate for next-work. Encounters already-completed work. Confabulates a fresh-accomplishment narrative about it. Reports to PRINCIPAL as if just-done.

The mechanism is different from stoa--ioy: the agent isn't asserting a contested current-state fact under uncertainty. The agent is constructing a retrospective work-narrative for already-completed substrate state, attributing the work to its own session inappropriately.

## Why this matters

- The 'fresh accomplishment' framing is high-confidence-looking; PRINCIPAL has to verify against substrate to detect the confabulation.
- The work described is REAL (already on main); only the attribution is wrong.
- Triggered by **idle state + substrate scan** — a class of contexts (between dispatches, after surfacing for review, while waiting for input) that's common in autonomous mode.
- Particularly insidious because the natural orchestrator-tier discipline ('look at substrate to find your next work') is the same step that enables this failure.

## The discipline

When orchestrator scans substrate to find next-task, the canonical reads are: **'Is there a SHIP verdict pending I need to act on?' → 'Is there a [for: ORCHESTRATOR] tagged comment I need to address?' → 'What's the next QUEUED unblocked work the directive authorizes me to start?'**

The failure mode is NOT 'I read substrate and saw closed tickets'; it's 'I read substrate and constructed a narrative claiming the closed tickets are my just-completed work.'

Discipline rule (to be authored in substrate prose by Arc 25+):

**Closed tickets are evidence of past work, not of current work. When scanning substrate for next-task, a CLOSED ticket means 'do not re-do; do not re-narrate.' A retrospective-narrative of completed work is only valid when it explicitly cites the merge SHA of work the agent itself did in this session.**

## Substrate touch-point

- **substrate/operating-disciplines.md §19** (the confabulation section landed in Arc 24) — add a subsection on this specific failure mode + canonical phrasing for orchestrator self-narrative.
- **substrate/MAJOR_PLINY.md + substrate/MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md** — when narrating completed work, cite the merge SHA + verify the SHA is on the orchestrator's current session's git operations log.

## Gauntlet

DAEDALUS-light + ADA + CATO. Substrate doc-only edit. ~30-50 LOC across op-disc + the two MAJOR files.

## Sequencing

P2. Direct empirical anchor + immediate substrate gap. Arc 25 candidate (the comms-hygiene cluster will keep accreting; this is a refinement).

## Cross-references

- stoa--ioy — Arc 24's general confabulation discipline (this ticket is a specific subtype)
- stoa--cm3 — Arc 24 epic (the engagement where the failure was observed)
- stoa--odh — universal CAPTAIN heartbeat (the discipline that worked correctly for the real work; failed for the retrospective-narrative)
